verdict.rationale: Canny's own native integrations let a PM send a feedback item to Jira, Linear, GitHub, ClickUp, or Asana, link it to existing issues or tasks, and sync statuses, so feedback becomes an actionable task. The task itself lives in an external tracker rather than inside Canny, the Jira integration is Cloud-only, and the evidence is one-line directory blurbs. missing for 10: native in-Canny task or project creation, detailed documentation of the feedback-to-task conversion flow (field mapping, what is created), support beyond Jira Cloud, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can turn a customer feedback submission directly into an actionable task or project intention
